units.source_text: 她漫不经心地说出这话，源氏大将听了只觉无限依恋之情。

en.t: She said this casually, and when General Genji heard it, he felt only an immeasurable longing and attachment.

units.source_text: 但倘再不退出，在她必然伤心，在我亦多痛苦，只得身不由己地告辞了。

en.t: But if he did not withdraw now, she would surely be hurt, and he too would suffer greatly; helpless against his own feelings, he had no choice but to take his leave.
